temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria has no specific belief yet that Cheryl is overwhelmed in this situation; she likely sees Cheryl as a colleague handling the community outreach project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Maria learns that Cheryl is currently overwhelmed and is receptive to assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is struggling with the project workload and welcomes Maria's help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, sympathetic, and willing to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria observes Cheryl handling responsibilities with improved confidence after the help. During a staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase, and Cheryl accepts, thanking Maria for her confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has improved and is capable, but she has not yet concluded that Cheryl should take on a leadership role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Maria's confidence in Cheryl's readiness strengthens, and Cheryl's acceptance confirms she is willing to lead.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is ready and willing to lead the next phase of the project; recommending her was appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and help the project succeed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately. Cheryl says she was a bit surprised but appreciates Maria's support and says it means a lot that Maria believes in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worries that Cheryl might perceive the leadership suggestion as overstepping or as pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Maria's worry is resolved because Cheryl appreciates the support and does not indicate feeling pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl values Maria's support; there are no hard feelings or misunderstandings.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ensure Cheryl feels supported and maintain a positive working relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project together. Cheryl enthusiastically agrees, says Maria's guidance has been invaluable, and says they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support, and she believes their relationship is positive but wants to strengthen their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Cheryl's enthusiastic agreement confirms that they can co-lead and work well together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl wants to co-lead and sees them as a strong team; their collaboration can be mutually supportive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Co-lead the project with Cheryl and support each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Cheryl says she would love to team up for more projects and that working with Maria has been wonderful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership is strong; she is joyful about their synergy.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Cheryl's enthusiasm confirms and strengthens Maria's belief in their future teamwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They have a strong, successful partnership and can achieve more together in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Cheryl for more projects in the future.
